cong_thuc.giai_thich: Nhan ban vung: vien marching-ants nhap nhay quanh vung copy. Dung khi nhan ban du lieu.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Boi den A1:A5 > Ctrl+C (vien nhap nhay) > chon C1 > Ctrl+V

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Dan vung copy/cut vao vi tri moi. Con tro dat o o tren-trai cua vung dich.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Chon C1 > Ctrl+V (du lieu copy xuat hien)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Cat/di chuyen: vung goc cung nhap nhay nhung se trang sau khi paste. Khac Copy (giu goc).
cong_thuc.vi_du: Boi den > Ctrl+X > sang vi tri moi > Ctrl+V (goc trang)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Hoan tac thao tac vua xong; nhan nhieu lan lui nhieu buoc (vd sau Replace All).
cong_thuc.vi_du: Ctrl+H > Replace All > Ctrl+Z (hoan tac)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tat vien nhap nhay sau copy/paste. Khong anh huong du lieu.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Ctrl+C > Ctrl+V > Esc (het nhap nhay)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Mo hop Find (the Find): tim kiem tu khoa trong sheet.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Ctrl+F > go 'hang' > Find Next / Find All

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Mo thang the Replace: thay the noi dung hang loat.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Ctrl+H > Find 'du lieu' > Replace 'Excel' > Replace All

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Find Next / Find All / Replace / Replace All
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Find Next: tung o; Find All: liet ke; Replace: tung cho; Replace All: tat ca.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Find All liet ke 5 o > Replace All thay 5 cho

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Bat/tat AutoFilter (loc du lieu). Nhan lai de tat.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Chon tieu de > Ctrl+Shift+L (mui ten loc hien ra)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Nhay toi bien (dau/cuoi) vung du lieu lien tuc. Rat nhanh voi bang dai.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Dung o A1 > Ctrl+Mui ten xuong (toi dong cuoi)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Ve o A1 tu bat ky dau trong sheet.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Dang o Z1000 > Ctrl+Home (ve A1)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Boi den tu o hien tai toi goc vung. Ket hop 2 huong de phu kin vung.
cong_thuc.vi_du: O A1 > Ctrl+Shift+Mui ten xuong + sang phai (chon ca vung)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Sang sheet ben phai (PgDn) / ben trai (PgUp).
cong_thuc.vi_du: Ctrl+PageDown (sang sheet ke tiep)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: 1:#,##0.00 (nghin+2 le); 2:gio; 3:ngay; 4:tien $; 5:%. Ap cho o dang chon.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Nhap 1000000/3 > Ctrl+Shift+1 (333,333.33); > Ctrl+Shift+5 (phan tram)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tu chen =SUM() cho cot/hang ke tren/trai o hien tai; Enter de chot.
cong_thuc.vi_du: O duoi cot so > Alt+= (hien =SUM(B2:B10)) > Enter

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Dan dac biet dang gia tri: bo cong thuc, chi lay so. Thu tu: Copy > Alt > H > V > V > Enter.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Copy cot cong thuc > Alt,H,V,V > Enter (chi con so)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Chen NGAY hom nay (gia tri co dinh, khong tu doi nhu TODAY()).
cong_thuc.vi_du: Chon o > Ctrl+; (hien ngay hom nay)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Chen GIO hien tai (co dinh). Them Shift so voi lenh ngay.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Chon o > Ctrl+Shift+; (hien gio)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Ngat dong trong cung 1 o (vd liet ke hang hoa). Can Wrap Text de hien dep.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Go 'Hang1' > Alt+Enter > 'Hang2' (2 dong 1 o)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Lan 1: chon vung lien tuc quanh o hien tai; lan 2: ca sheet.
cong_thuc.vi_du: O trong vung > Ctrl+A (chon vung); lan nua (ca sheet)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Ve bieu do cot tu dong tu vung dang chon, ngay tren sheet hien tai.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Boi den vung so > Alt+F1 (chart hien ra)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Chon ca hang / ca cot cua o hien tai; boi den them de chon nhieu.
cong_thuc.vi_du: O B3 > Shift+Space (hang 3); > Ctrl+Space (cot B)

cong_thuc.ten: Chen hang/cot — Ctrl+Shift+Dau cong (+) roi R/C
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Mo hop Insert: go R (=Row) chen hang, C (=Column) chen cot. Boi den N o de chen N hang/cot.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Boi den 2 o > Ctrl+Shift++ > R > Enter (chen 2 hang)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Mo hop Delete: go R xoa hang, C xoa cot.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Chon cot > Ctrl+- > C > Enter (xoa cot)

cong_thuc.ten: Di chuyen chen — Giu Shift + keo chuot
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Di chuyen/chen hang-cot ma khong de len du lieu cu (vach xanh hien vi tri chen).
cong_thuc.vi_du: Boi den 2 hang > giu Shift + keo toi vach xanh > tha

cong_thuc.giai_thich: An hang/cot dang chon; Ctrl+Z hoac Unhide de hien lai. Chon nhieu de an hang loat.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Chon hang 5:7 > Ctrl+9 (an 3 hang)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Chon cac o VISIBLE sau khi an/loc, bo qua o an khi copy (tranh copy ca dong an).
cong_thuc.vi_du: Loc + an hang > boi den > Alt+; > Ctrl+C > Ctrl+V (chi o thay)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Dien nhanh theo mau (tu Excel 2013): go mau 1 o (Nguyen Van An) roi Ctrl+E dien ca cot.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Cot Ho + Ten > go mau 'Nguyen Van An' > Ctrl+E (dien ca cot)

steps.thao_tac: Buoc 1 (Luyen copy-paste-undo): Tai file thuc hanh bai 23 (link mo ta) > Boi den vung mau > Ctrl+C (vien nhap nhay) > chon cho moi > Ctrl+V > Esc thoat nhap nhay; Ctrl+X thu cut; Ctrl+Z undo tung buoc
steps.luu_y: Kiem tra vung sau paste/fill; Ctrl+Z ngay neu sai

steps.thao_tac: Buoc 2 (Luyen Find-Replace): Ctrl+F tim 'hang' > Find Next / Find All > Ctrl+H thay 'du lieu' thanh 'Excel' > Replace / Replace All > Ctrl+Z undo 1-2 buoc de kiem tra
steps.luu_y: Kiem tra vung sau paste/fill; Ctrl+Z ngay neu sai

steps.thao_tac: Buoc 3 (Loc + dieu huong): Ctrl+Shift+L bat AutoFilter > Ctrl+Mui ten nhay goc; Ctrl+Shift+Mui ten boi den; Ctrl+Home ve A1 > Ctrl+PageDown/PageUp chuyen sheet
Buoc 4 (Dinh dang + tong + gia tri): Nhap 1000000/3 roi Ctrl+Shift+1..5 xem 5 kieu > Alt+= tinh tong cot/hang ke tren/trai > Enter > Copy cot cong thuc > Alt,H,V,V dan gia tri

Buoc 5 (Ngay-gio-xuong dong-chart-insert): Ctrl+; chen ngay; Ctrl+Shift+; chen gio; Alt+Enter xuong dong trong o > Ctrl+A chon vung/sheet; Alt+F1 ve chart > Shift/Ctrl+Space chon hang/cot; Ctrl+Shift++ (R/C) chen; Ctrl+- (R/C) xoa; Shift+keo di chuyen; Ctrl+9/0 an; Alt+; chon hien; Ctrl+E Flash Fill

Thực hiện bước: Buoc 2 (Luyen Find-Replace): Ctrl+F tim 'hang' > Find Next / Find All > Ctrl+H thay 'du lieu' thanh 'Excel' > Replace / Replace All > Ctrl+Z undo 1-2 buoc de ki
Thực hiện bước: Buoc 3 (Loc + dieu huong): Ctrl+Shift+L bat AutoFilter > Ctrl+Mui ten nhay goc; Ctrl+Shift+Mui ten boi den; Ctrl+Home ve A1 > Ctrl+PageDown/PageUp chuyen sheet
Thực hiện bước: Buoc 4 (Dinh dang + tong + gia tri): Nhap 1000000/3 roi Ctrl+Shift+1..5 xem 5 kieu > Alt+= tinh tong cot/hang ke tren/trai > Enter > Copy cot cong thuc > Alt,H,
Thực hiện bước: Buoc 5 (Ngay-gio-xuong dong-chart-insert): Ctrl+; chen ngay; Ctrl+Shift+; chen gio; Alt+Enter xuong dong trong o > Ctrl+A chon vung/sheet; Alt+F1 ve chart > Shi
